newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1997 GDP growth barely above 2.0 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: French 1997 GDP growth barely above 2.0 pct - paper.

text.p: French economists expect 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) growth of 2.07 percent after a 1.15 percent climb in 1996, according to a poll published on Monday in financial daily Les Echos.
The poll's predictions were weaker than French government forecasts of 1.3 percent this year and 2.3 percent in 1997.
The poll found that economists on average predicted France's public deficits would represent 3.44 percent of GDP in 1997 after 4.33 this year.
Consumer consumption growth was expected to fall to 1.65 percent in 1997 from 2.13 percent this year while business investment was seen rising 3.95 percent next year after 1.21 percent in 1996.
Consumer prices were expected to rise 1.88 percent in 1997 after a 1.7 percent rise in 1996 and unemployment was expected to fall to 12.29 percent in 1997 from 12.53 percent this year.
